Подивимось серію мультика про гру з пові:
We'll watch a cartoon episode about a balloon game and understand its rules
We'll learn game words: catch, hit, drop, the floor
We'll practise the imperative: Catch it! Don’t drop it!
We'll invent our own game and explain its rules
Покажи справжню або намальовану повітрян: Show a real or drawn balloon and ask: What is it? What colour is it? Children can give short answers. If you have a balloon, pass it around: whoever holds the balloon answers the question. Don't correct mistakes at this stage, the main thing is to get the children talking. 5 minutes.
повітряна кулька: a rubber ball filled with air
вдарити: to strike something with your hand
зловити: to take hold of something moving through the air
торкатися: to put your hand or body on something
підлога: the surface you walk on inside a room
обережний: paying attention to avoid danger or mistakes
правило: something that tells you what you must or must not do
перемогти: to be first in a game
останній: the final one, after all others
Match the English word with its meaning.
Встав слово: balloon, floor, high, caref: Fill in the word: balloon, floor, high, careful.
Покажи кожне слово рухом (TPR): to hit -: Show each word with a movement (TPR): to hit - gently tap upwards with your palm, to catch - catch, to drop - «drop» something from your hands, to fall - slowly crouch down, the floor - touch the floor. Then play «Simon says»: Simon says catch! Simon says touch the floor! Anyone who follows a command without «Simon says» is out for one round. 12 minutes including the exercises.
Подивись серію (7 хв). Яке головне прави: Watch the episode (7 min). What is the main rule of the game? What must you not do with the balloon?
Bluey: Keepy Uppy (офіційний канал Disne: Bluey: Keepy Uppy (official Disney Jr. channel)
Перед переглядом дай одне завдання: знай: Before watching, give one task: find the main rule of the game. While watching, ask the children to repeat phrases from the cartoon together with the characters and to show with their hands when the balloon goes up or falls. Questions after the video are general only: the rule of the game, who is playing, what they do with the balloon. You can play keepy uppy with a real balloon in class, or with an «imaginary» balloon on Zoom.
Яке головне правило гри? Обери відповідь: What is the main rule of the game? Choose the answer.
Catch it! Don’t drop it! · 10 хв: Catch it! Don’t drop it! · 10 min
Коли кажемо комусь, що робити, починаємо: When we tell someone what to do, we start with the verb: **Catch it! Hit it! Run!** When we tell them what not to do, we put **Don’t** at the beginning: **Don’t drop it! Don’t run!** The word **please** makes a request polite: **Please be careful!**
Fill in the word: catch, hit, don’t, be.
Після правила зіграй у «Вчитель-робот»:: After the rule, play «Robot teacher»: the student gives you commands in English (Hit it! Don’t run! Touch the floor!), and you follow them. If the student says «No drop it», do the command «wrong» and ask back in a funny way: Don’t drop it? This way the child corrects the mistake on their own. 10 minutes.
Дай дитині 2 хвилини подумати і, якщо тр: Give the child 2 minutes to think and, if needed, draw their game. Then the student explains the rules, and you try playing together for 1-2 minutes (on Zoom you can use a pillow or a soft toy). Make up one «weird» rule yourself too (Don’t laugh!) to make it fun. Correct imperative mistakes by asking back.
Write 3 rules of your game in English.
Наприкінці повтори 3-4 слова через жести: At the end, review 3-4 words with gestures: you show the movement, the student names the verb. Homework: play keepy uppy with the family and record a voice message with three rules (Do… / Don’t…), or draw a «Rules of our game» poster with captions in English.
Вивчимо слова про ферму і тварин\nПодиви:
We'll learn words about the farm and animals
We'll watch a cartoon without words and tell the story ourselves
We'll practise the Present Continuous: The sheep are running
We'll describe a picture and play «What am I doing?»
Зіграй «Animal sounds»: ти видаєш звук т: Play «Animal sounds»: you make an animal sound, the student names the animal in English (Baa - a sheep, Oink - a pig, Woof - a dog, Moo - a cow). Then swap roles. Don't insist on full sentences, 5 minutes for the warm-up.
вівця (дві вівці): a woolly farm animal (the plural is also sheep)
фермер: a person who works on a farm
свиня: a pink farm animal with a curly tail
поле: an open area of land with grass or crops
паркан: a wall of wood or wire around a field
хлів, сарай: a big farm building for animals
ховатися: to go where nobody can see you
лізти: to go up using your hands and feet
У множині sheep не змінюється: one sheep: In the plural, sheep doesn't change: one sheep, ten sheep. No -s!
Match the word with its meaning.
Покажи дієслова рухами (TPR): run - біг: Show the verbs with movements (TPR): run - run on the spot, hide - cover your face with your hands, climb - «climb» upwards with your hands, jump - a jump, sleep - palms under your cheek. You say the verb, the child shows it, then the other way round. Pay special attention to sheep without -s. 12 minutes including the exercises.
У цьому мультику ніхто не говорить, тож: Nobody talks in this cartoon, so you will do the talking! Let's watch the first episode (about 7 min).
У відео підбірка з 10 серій, на урок дос: The video is a compilation of 10 episodes; the first one is enough for the lesson. The first time, watch 2-3 minutes without pauses, then do the general understanding exercise. After that, pause every 30-60 seconds and ask: What is the farmer doing? What are the sheep doing? Where is the dog? The student answers with a Present Continuous sentence. Only ask about what is visible on the screen. Write any missing words in the student's vocabulary list.
Що особливого в цьому мультику? Обери ві: What is special about this cartoon? Choose the answer.
Що відбувається зараз: **am / is / are +: What is happening now: **am / is / are + verb with -ing**. The dog **is running**. The sheep **are hiding**. Question: **Is** the dog **running**? Yes, it is. / No, it isn’t.
Перед вправою покажи 3-4 стоп-кадри з му: Before the exercise, show 3-4 freeze-frames from the cartoon and build sentences together using the pattern «who + is/are + action-ing». Typical mistake: The dog running (without is). Correct it with a gesture: show the «missing word» with your fingers and let the child add is on their own. 10 minutes.
Speaking: постав відео на паузу і запиши: Speaking: pause the video and record what is happening.
Гра «Charades»: ти без слів показуєш дію: «Charades»: you act out an action without words (You are a sheep and you are hiding), the child guesses: You are hiding! Then swap roles, and you do the guessing. It's the same idea as the cartoon without words. Next, a voice recording about a freeze-frame. 12 minutes.
Напиши 3 речення: що зараз роблять люди: Write 3 sentences: what are the people or animals in your home doing right now?
Підсумок: дитина називає 3 нові слова і: Wrap-up: the child names 3 new words and one sentence in the Present Continuous. Homework: watch another episode of Shaun the Sheep, pause it anywhere, draw that moment and write 3 sentences under it (The sheep are…, The dog is…).
Вивчимо слова про соцмережі: post, follo:
We'll learn social media words: post, follow, scroll, screen time
We'll read and listen to teenagers' stories about life online
We'll practise adverbs of frequency: always, usually, never
We'll discuss how to spend time online safely and usefully
Спершу коротке обговорення, потім учень: Start with a short discussion, then the student fills in the scale. Ask them to explain one answer: Why do you agree? Don't correct mistakes, just note 2-3 typical ones for the Language focus stage. 5 minutes.
публікувати: to put a photo, video or text online
підписник: a person who subscribes to your account
гортати стрічку: to move through a feed on a screen
час перед екраном: the time you spend looking at a screen
ділитися: to let others see something you found or made
сповіщення: a message on your phone that tells you about something new
коментар: a short message written under a post
вподобати, лайкнути: to show that you enjoy a post
приватний: only for you or chosen people
профіль: a page with information about a user
заблокувати: to stop someone from contacting you
Покажи свій (або вигаданий) профіль у со: Show your own (or a made-up) social media profile and name its parts: profile, post, comment, like, followers. The student repeats and points at the screen. For quick revision: you give the meaning, the student says the English word, as fast as possible. 10 minutes.
Перший раз учень читає швидко (2 хвилини: The first time, the student reads quickly (2 minutes) and answers the questions about the main idea. Then they read again for details. After checking, ask them to find all the adverbs of frequency in the text (usually, never, often, always, sometimes) and underline them: this is a bridge to the grammar. 15 minutes.
Прислівники частоти (always, usually, of: Adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) go **before the main verb**: She usually posts. But **after to be**: She is always online. Question: **How often** do you post?
Він завжди онлайн увечері: He is always online in the evening
Поверни помилки з розминки і виправте їх: Bring back the mistakes from the warm-up and correct them together. Typical mistake: I post usually. Show the word order on a «ruler»: who + adverb + verb. You can give the student cards with the words of a sentence so they put them in the right order. 10 minutes.
Аудіо прослухати двічі: спершу без завда: Play the audio twice: first without a task (who talks about what), then with True/False. Next, a role play: the student and the teacher are Max and Sofia a week later. The student must use at least 2 adverbs of frequency and 2 new words. Correct gently by repeating the phrase correctly. 14 minutes.
Якщо часу мало, учень пише лише 3 реченн: If time is short, the student writes only 3 rule sentences. Homework: check their screen time statistics for the week and record a 1-minute voice message: How much time do I spend online? What can I change? You can suggest their own challenge for the week, like Mia's.
Прочитаємо і послухаємо історії про незв:
We'll read and listen to stories about unusual travel adventures
We'll learn words for telling a story about a trip
We'll practise the Past Simple and Past Continuous: We were walking when we saw a bear
We'll tell our own travel story
Покажи 2-3 фото зі своєї поїздки (або ка: Show 2-3 photos from your own trip (or pictures from the internet) and ask the student to guess what happened. This sets the mood for the topic of «stories». Don't correct grammar during the warm-up, just note mistakes with past tenses. 5 minutes.
поїздка: a journey to a place and back
заблукати: to not know where you are or how to get somewhere
помітити: to see or become aware of something
краєвид: what you can see from a place, especially nature
спізнитися (на потяг): to be too late for (a train)
сувенір: a thing you buy to remember a place
Попроси учня розповісти міні-історію з 3: Ask the student to tell a mini-story of 3 sentences using suddenly, luckily and one other new word. Pay attention to pronunciation: quietly (don't confuse it with quite), souvenir with the stress on the last syllable. 10 minutes.
Перед читанням питання: What do you thin: Pre-reading question: What do you think happened near the lake? First reading for general understanding (choosing the title), second for details. After the exercises, ask the student to find 3 examples of the Past Continuous and 3 of the Past Simple in the text. 15 minutes.
**Past Continuous** (was/were + V-ing) о: The **Past Continuous** (was/were + V-ing) describes the background, that is, what was going on: The sun was shining. The **Past Simple** describes an event that interrupted this background: We were walking to the hotel **when** it started to rain. After **while** we usually use the Past Continuous: **While** we were having dinner, the phone rang.
Ми їхали в потязі, коли я побачив свого: We were travelling on the train when I saw my teacher
Поки мама купувала квитки, ми чекали в к: While Mum was buying the tickets, we were waiting in a café
Намалюй часову лінію: довга хвиляста лін: Draw a timeline: a long wavy line (Past Continuous) and a short «lightning bolt» (Past Simple) that interrupts it. Ask the student to make up their own sentence using this pattern. The translation can have several correct versions: if the answer makes sense, accept it manually. 10 minutes.
Аудіо прослухати двічі. Потім гра «Story: Play the audio twice. Then play «Story chain»: the teacher and student take turns adding one sentence each to the story, using when / while / suddenly / luckily. Next, the student tells their own story for 1-2 minutes. Only correct mistakes with past tenses, by repeating the phrase correctly. 14 minutes.
Якщо часу мало, учень пише лише перші 3-: If time is short, the student writes only the first 3-4 sentences and finishes at home. Homework: complete the story to 120-150 words and add a photo or drawing; or record a 1-2 minute spoken story about a real trip.
Навчимося говорити про життєвий досвід з:
We'll learn to talk about life experience with the Present Perfect
We'll tell the difference between the Present Perfect and the Past Simple
We'll do NMT-format tasks: reading and a grammar test
We'll ask each other Have you ever…? questions
Дай свої три речення з Present Perfect:: Give your own three sentences with the Present Perfect: I have been to Poland. I have never eaten sushi. I have met a famous singer. The student guesses the lie and asks questions. Then the student makes their own three sentences. Don't explain the grammar, just point out that all the sentences are about experience «at some point in life». 5 minutes.
з (якогось моменту): from (a point in time) until now
за кордоном: in or to a foreign country
досвід, враження: something that happens to you, an impression
спробувати: to do or taste something to see what it is like
Нарисуй часову лінію від минулого до «no: Draw a timeline from the past to «now» and place on it just (a moment ago), already, since 2019, for 6 years. The student explains in their own words the difference between since and for. Quick game: you say «2020», the student says «since 2020»; you say «three days», the student says «for three days». 10 minutes.
НМТ-формат: match the paragraphs (A-D) w: NMT format: match the paragraphs (A-D) with the headings.
NMT format: choose the correct answer.
Формат як у НМТ: спершу заголовки до абз: The format is like the NMT: first headings for the paragraphs (30-40 seconds per paragraph, look for key words), then the detail task. Teach a strategy: underline the key word in the question and look for a synonym in the text. After checking, find examples of the Present Perfect and the Past Simple in the text and explain why that tense is used (two years ago, last spring - exact time). 15 minutes.
Present Perfect (have / has + V3) говори: The Present Perfect (have / has + V3) talks about experience without an exact time: I have been to Lviv. If there is an exact time (yesterday, in 2022, two years ago), we need the Past Simple: I went to Lviv in 2022. A typical dialogue: **Have you ever been** to Lviv? Yes, I have. **When did you go** there? I **went** last summer.
Я ще не зробив домашнє завдання: I haven't done my homework yet
НМТ-формат: read the text and choose the: NMT format: read the text and choose the correct option for each gap.
Останнє завдання - у форматі граматичног: The last task is in the format of the NMT grammar test (choosing from four options in a connected text). Ask the student to first find the «time marker» in each sentence (so far, last year, never, just) and only then choose. Go over mistakes with the question: Is there a finished time? 12 minutes.
НМТ-style speaking practice: record a 1-: NMT-style speaking practice: record a 1-minute answer.
Після аудіо зверни увагу на модель: пита: After the audio, draw attention to the model: the question is in the Present Perfect, and the follow-up (When? How?) is in the Past Simple. Game «Find someone who…»: the student asks questions from a card (…has eaten something strange, …has been abroad, …has met a famous person), and every Yes gets a follow-up in the Past Simple. Then a voice recording. 12 minutes.
Наприкінці учень називає одну різницю мі: At the end, the student names one difference between the Present Perfect and the Past Simple in their own words. Homework: make a bucket list of 10 items and mark what has already been done (I have already…) and what hasn't yet (I haven’t… yet); extra - one NMT-format grammar exercise on the platform.
Обговоримо, навіщо вчити кілька мов\nПод:
We'll discuss why it's worth learning several languages
We'll watch a short TED-Ed video and check understanding
We'll learn words about the brain and learning, plus phrases for giving arguments
We'll express and defend our opinion
Почни з короткого обговорення, потім шка: Start with a short discussion, then the scale. Ask the student to explain one of their answers and promise to come back to it after the video: will their opinion change? Don't correct mistakes at this stage. 5 minutes.
рідна мова: the first language you learn as a child
засвоювати, набувати: to get or learn something, such as a skill or language
мозок: the organ in your head that you think with
перемикатися: to change from one thing to another
перевага: something that helps you or gives you a better position
вільний (про мову): able to speak a language easily and well
навичка: an ability to do something well
зосереджуватися: to give all your attention to something
Перед вправами попроси учня розділити сл: Before the exercises, ask the student to divide the words into two groups: «brain» (brain, memory, focus) and «languages» (fluent, native language, bilingual). Check pronunciation: acquire, advantage, fluent. 10 minutes.
Подивись відео (5 хв). Спершу просто зро: Watch the video (5 min). First just understand the main idea, then do the exercises.
Відео з англійськими субтитрами на YouTu: The video has English subtitles on YouTube. At B1, watch it twice: first for general understanding (the main idea exercise), then for details. Check the True/False answers together, going back to moments in the video. If it's hard for the student, turn on subtitles and set the speed to 0.75. 15 minutes.
Говоримо про переваги і недоліки: **One: Talking about advantages and disadvantages: **One advantage of … is that …** / **It helps you to …** / **The best thing about … is …** / **One disadvantage is that …** / **On the other hand, …** After **It helps you** you can use a verb with or without **to**: It helps you (to) remember words.
Одна з переваг двомовності в тому, що мо: One advantage of being bilingual is that the brain stays active
Це допомагає тобі краще запам’ятовувати: It helps you to remember words better
Попроси учня усно зробити 3 речення про: Ask the student to make 3 spoken sentences about the advantages of English, using different phrases from the hint. The translation can have several versions: if the answer is correct in meaning, accept it manually. Typical mistake: One advantage is learning languages is... - show the structure One advantage of + -ing + is that. 10 minutes.
Міні-дебати: вчитель бере протилежну поз: Mini-debate: the teacher takes the opposite position, the student defends theirs. Each side speaks for 1 minute, then 1 minute to respond. Watch for the phrases One advantage of…, On the other hand… Note mistakes and go over them after the debate, not during it. 14 minutes.
Якщо учень не встигає, нехай напише план: If the student runs out of time, let them write a plan and the first sentence, and finish the post at home. Homework: complete the post to 100-120 words; or find someone who speaks 2+ languages, do a short interview (3 questions) and talk about it in the next lesson.
